## Summary

**EXTUB** (Extend Unsigned Byte/Word): Extend with zeros to long.

## Details

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Operation | `Dn → Dn.L` |
| Syntax | `EXTUB.L Dn`<br>`EXTUW.L Dn` |
| Short | Extend with zeros to long. |
| Description | Unsigned extend. Extend data register with zeros to long. Source size can be byte or word. |
| Condition codes | see table |

### Condition codes

| X | N | Z | V | C |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| – | 0 | * | 0 | 0 |

### Encoding

| Word | Bits | Content |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 15–11 | `01001` |
| 1 | 10–9 | Size |
| 1 | 8–3 | `111000` |
| 1 | 2–0 | Register |

- Size 01=byte to long, 10=word to long

### Example

```asm
    extub.l    d0
```

```text
reg d0: .. .. .. .. .. .. .. E3
Result:
reg d0: .. .. .. .. 00 00 00 E3
```

## Differences from AmigaOS / AROS / 68060

- The 68000–68060 have no EXTUB. It is new on the 68080.

## Do / Don't

- No rules beyond the details above.
